items.statement: The optimized 4-(methylsulfanyl)benzyl alcohol radical cation is validated as a stationary minimum by vibrational analysis.
items.expected: Zero imaginary frequencies are reported for the vacuum 2g•+ radical cation.

items.statement: The unique sulfur atom carries substantial Hirshfeld spin density in 2g•+.
items.expected: Hirshfeld spin density on sulfur is 0.401 (dimensionless atomic spin population).

items.statement: The benzylic C–H BDE of 2g is higher than that of the methoxy analogue under the defined comparison.
items.expected: 2g BDE is 198.5 kJ mol−1 and 2a BDE is 173.7 kJ mol−1, so 2g is higher by 24.8 kJ mol−1.
